statement: No correct circuit of fan-in-2 AND/OR gates and at most 2 NOT gates has fewer than base gates on: triangle of triples (base 6), Pasch (8), star of 3 triples (6), tri4 (6), q4 (7), Fano minus 2 lines (n = 7, base 10); exact SAT at s = base - 1 is UNSAT. With unbounded NOT gates also UNSAT on the first five.

The general witness count |witness(empty)| >= base holds on 2,400/2,400 SAT-enumerated correct circuits with exactly 2 NOT gates (no NOT of NOT) and on 2,700/2,700 with exactly 3 NOT gates, on tri3, star3, tri4, q4 at s = base+3 .. base+5. Not adversarial (SAT order).

With exactly 2 NOT gates, neither feeding the other, the minimum circuit size is base + 3 on tri3, star3 and tri4 (UNSAT at base + 1, base + 2) and above base + 2 on q4 and Pasch: on these systems NOT gates cost gates, never save them.
